courses.title: Effective Code Review Practices
courses.description: Effective Code Review Practices focuses on code review practices for people working toward a Senior Software Engineer role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces ci/cd pipelines, enough to apply alongside code review practices in real Senior Software Engineer work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to code review practices and show how ci/cd pipelines supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying code review practices to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing code review practices through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to ci/cd pipelines
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Technical Leadership
courses.description: Applying Technical Leadership is a focused course on technical leadership for people already working toward a Senior Software Engineer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying technical leadership on your own.

courses.title: Getting Started with Performance Tuning
courses.description: Getting Started with Performance Tuning is a short introduction to performance tuning for people moving toward a Senior Software Engineer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show performance tuning in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if performance tuning is new to you.

courses.title: A Short Guide to Incident Response
courses.description: A Short Guide to Incident Response walks you through the basics of incident response, built for people new to Senior Software Engineer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of incident response, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
